question: 单项选择：I want _____ a doctor when I grow up. A. be  B. to be  C. being  D. been
answer: 答案：B. to be。解析：want to do是固定搭配。want to be a doctor"想成为一名医生"。

question: 单项选择：She decided _____ abroad for further study. A. go  B. to go  C. going  D. goes
answer: 答案：B. to go。解析：decide to do"决定做"。abroad"在国外"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：They plan ______ (travel) to Japan next year.
answer: 答案：to travel。解析：plan to do"计划做"。Japan"日本"。

question: 单项选择：I hope _____ the truth. A. know  B. to know  C. knowing  D. knows
answer: 答案：B. to know。解析：hope to do"希望做"。the truth"真相"。

question: 翻译句子：我想学游泳。
answer: 答案：I want to learn to swim. 解析：want to do"想做"。learn to swim"学游泳"。

question: 单项选择：He agreed _____ me with my English. A. help  B. to help  C. helping  D. helps
answer: 答案：B. to help。解析：agree to do"同意做"。help sb. with"帮助某人做某事"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She wants ______ (find) a good job after graduation.
answer: 答案：to find。解析：want to do"想要做"。graduation"毕业"。

question: 单项选择：I need _____ harder to pass the exam. A. study  B. to study  C. studying  D. studied
answer: 答案：B. to study。解析：need to do"需要做"。pass the exam"通过考试"。

question: 翻译句子：他决定戒烟。
answer: 答案：He decided to quit smoking. 解析：decide to do"决定做"。quit smoking"戒烟"。

question: 单项选择：She seems _____ tired. Let's take a break. A. to be  B. be  C. being  D. is
answer: 答案：A. to be。解析：seem to be"看起来是"。tired"累的"。
